The [[Miniature Kuunavang]] is a [[miniature]] version of [[Kuunavang]].

==Acquisition==
*[[Factions Collector's Edition Present]]

==Notes== 
* This miniature flies. 
* As opposed to [[promotional weapon]]s, which can be obtained multiple times, you can only get this miniature ''once''.
* Occasionally, while in explorable areas, it will roar and make a noise resembling the flapping of wings.
